nodes.notes: Builds one constrained local-model request from Phase 1 text and its complete Phase 2 Main Issue.

nodes.name: Extract Date and Epistemic Status
nodes.notes: First local LM Studio call: detect only complete Event Candidates.

nodes.name: Capture Date and Epistemic Response
nodes.notes: Parses only the stated JSON shapes and keeps every complete candidate; quote uncertainty becomes NEEDS_REVIEW.

nodes.name: Has Actors for Safeguard?
nodes.notes: Only candidates with a verified quote reach the independent safeguard.

nodes.name: Build Actor Safeguard Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds one local safeguard request for all quote-verified candidates from the article.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'google/gemma-4-12b-qat', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.p4_actor_safeguard_prompt }], temperature: 0.1, max_tokens: 1024, reasoning_effort: 'none' } }}

nodes.name: Safeguard Actors
nodes.notes: Second local LM Studio call: independently checks each verified candidate.

nodes.name: Apply Actor Safeguard
nodes.notes: Converts each individual safeguard review into VALID or complete NEEDS_REVIEW candidates.

nodes.name: Save Phase 4 Event Facts
nodes.notes: Creates the latest Phase 3 result through a Supabase node; no Code node writes data.

nodes.name: Prepare Phase 4 Processing Run
nodes.notes: Maps the saved Supabase latest result to the append-only run contract.

nodes.name: Save Phase 4 Event Fact Processing Run
nodes.notes: Appends immutable Phase 3 run history through a Supabase node.

nodes.name: Existing Phase 4 Result?
nodes.notes: Routes retry results to Supabase Update and first attempts to Supabase Create.

nodes.name: Update Failed Phase 4 Event Facts
nodes.notes: Updates only the existing FAILED latest result through a Supabase node; prior attempts remain in run history.

parameters.jsCode:
const rules=['Review locations only. The title is an identity label only.','Use the candidate evidence quote only to define the event boundary. Judge each location against its own evidence_quote in the complete cleaned article, and accept only when that quote shows the same candidate event occurred there.','Reject datelines, publication or reporter locations, actor homes or bases, and places from background or related events unless the candidate event occurred there. Do not use candidate description, the candidate evidence quote, outside knowledge, normalization, country codes, coordinates, or geocoding as proof of a location.','Return one indexed decision for every location.','Return only {"decisions":[{"index":0,"decision":"ACCEPT","reason":null}]}; use REJECT with a concrete reason when unsupported.'].join('
');return [{json:{...$json,p4_location_safeguard_prompt:rules+'

Event title:
'+String($json.candidate_title??'')+'

Candidate evidence scope:
'+String($json.candidate_evidence_quote??'')+'

Locations:
'+JSON.stringify($json.p4_location_candidates)+'

Complete cleaned article:
'+$json.cleaned_content_text}}];
